## Features
- Heavy-duty white rubber cable, waterproof
- Connectable up to 50m for custom displays
- Energy-saving leds with warm white glow

## Information
Create a magical atmosphere with these Warm White LED Icicle Lights, designed with a striking 60/40/20cm drop pattern and finished on durable white rubber cable. Part of our mains voltage light system, these icicle lights are built for both indoor and outdoor use, making them a versatile option for year-round decoration. With the ability to connect multiple sets together, you can easily tailor the length to suit anything from a small porch or pergola to a full house frontage. Manufactured with heavy-duty rubber cable and waterproof ends, these icicle lights are weather-resistant and suitable for all seasons. The long-life LED bulbs provide a bright yet warm glow that enhances the charm of your outdoor or indoor setting, while also being energy efficient and reliable. Available in 2m and 5m sections, these connectable lights allow you to achieve up to 50m of continuous display with ease. Perfect for adding elegance to gutters, eaves, patios, garden structures or festive displays, they are equally at home enhancing summer evenings as they are creating a festive winter scene. Whether you choose to install them permanently or bring them out for special occasions, these Warm White Icicle Lights are designed to deliver long-lasting performance and an inviting glow that transforms any space.

## Features
- 45 Multicolour SMD LEDs
- Infinity mirror effect
- USB rechargeable light
- IP20 indoor use only

## Information
Bring the colourful world of Toy Story into your home with this 20cm Disney Toy Story Lotso LED Infinity Mirror Light. Featuring the instantly recognisable pink Lotso character in a cheerful seated pose, this decorative light combines a playful Disney Pixar design with an eye-catching illuminated mirror effect. Powered by 45 multi-colour SMD LEDs, the light creates a bright and colourful display across Lotso's character design. The clever infinity mirror effect repeatedly reflects the LEDs within the mirrored sections, creating the illusion of a tunnel of light stretching into the decoration and adding impressive depth when illuminated. The detailed character-shaped design features Lotso's familiar pink colouring, contrasting lighter face, paws and tummy, and a fun raised-arm pose. A sturdy freestanding base allows the light to sit neatly on a shelf, desk, bedside table, sideboard or other flat surface, making it easy to incorporate into bedrooms, playrooms and Toy Story-themed spaces. At approximately 20cm tall, it offers plenty of visual impact without taking up too much room. Whether used as an everyday Disney character light, part of a Toy Story collection, a colourful bedroom decoration or a gift for a Disney Pixar fan, this Lotso infinity mirror light provides a distinctive illuminated feature both switched on and off.
